title: Legion of Super-Heroes #284 DC 1982 Medicus One Pat Broderick Cover
conditionDescription: Bright cover, light handling wear. Small handwritten "C-756" at the lower left of the front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Legion of Super-Heroes #284 (February 1982), DC Comics - Medicus One, the satellite hospital. Pat Broderick cover. 60 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Challenge #8860 Auto Chassis ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear. Small handwritten "C-756" at the lower left of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
